tasks.title: TimeEntry model with the single-timer index
tasks.description: server/src/models/timeEntryModel.ts: workspace, task, user, startedAt, endedAt, minutes, note and running with the { workspace, user, startedAt } and { task } indexes plus the partial unique index on { workspace, user } where running is true.

tasks.title: Pure time tracking helpers and their tests
tasks.description: server/src/utils/timeTracking.ts (minutesBetween, timerEnd, dayKey, parseRangeBound, summarizeEntries, formatMinutes, csvCell, toCsvRows) with server/src/__tests__/timeTracking.test.ts.

tasks.title: Manual logging with its validation chain
tasks.description: addTimeEntry and validateTimeEntry in server/src/controllers/timeController.ts: minutes or start plus end, the 1440-minute ceiling, the 200-character note, the future-start guard and the 201 response with entry and loggedMinutes.

tasks.title: Timer start and stop with the one-timer rule
tasks.description: startTimer stops and logs a timer running elsewhere and returns the entry already running on the same task, stopTimer ends the entry with the 1440-minute cap and a minimum of one minute, and both rely on the partial unique index for the racing case.

tasks.title: Task total resync, deletion rules and the task time read
tasks.description: syncLogged recomputes loggedMinutes from the stopped entries after log, stop and delete; deleteTimeEntry allows the author or settings:manage and logs time.deleted; getTaskTime returns the estimate, the total, the caller's running entry and up to 500 entries.

tasks.title: Route wiring on the tasks router
tasks.description: GET/POST /:id/time, POST /:id/timer/start, POST /:id/timer/stop and DELETE /:id/time/:entryId on server/src/routes/taskRoutes.ts with tasks:read or tasks:write and the validation chain in place.

tasks.title: Timesheet filters, totals and limits
tasks.description: timesheetFilter and loadSheet in server/src/controllers/timeController.ts: range bounds, the user filter for settings:manage, the project filter through task ids, the stopped-only rule, the 5000-row limit with the truncated flag, and the totals by user, day and task with project keys resolved in one query.

tasks.title: Running timer endpoint
tasks.description: getRunningTimer returns the caller's running entry with its task key, or { entry: null }, so the header pill and the task dialog read the same source.

tasks.title: CSV export with the formula guard
tasks.description: exportTimesheet reuses the filter logic with a 20000-row limit and writes the ten-column CSV with a UTF-8 byte-order mark, quoting through csvCell and a filename carrying the workspace slug and the day.

tasks.title: Workspace time router
tasks.description: server/src/routes/timeRoutes.ts with /running, /export.csv and the timesheet at the root, mounted at /:slug/time from server/src/routes/workspaceRoutes.ts behind protect and requirePermission('tasks:read').

tasks.title: Duration helpers and the shared timer store
tasks.description: client/src/features/time/lib/duration.ts (parseDuration, formatDuration, describeDuration, formatElapsed, timeProgress, describeProgress) and timerStore.ts (subscribeTimer, getTimerSnapshot, refreshTimer, selectWorkspace, startTimer, stopTimer, notifyTimeChanged, TIME_CHANGED_EVENT).

tasks.title: Time section in the task dialog
tasks.description: TaskTimeSection.tsx with the estimate field, the logged total, TimeProgressBar, the entry list, start and stop, LogTimePopover and deletion, backed by useTaskTime and useRunningTimer (reload on the time-changed event and on focus).

tasks.title: Header timer pill
tasks.description: TimerPill.tsx rendering the running timer with the task key, the elapsed clock and a stop button, shown by the app shell and hidden without a timer or tasks:read.

tasks.title: Weekly timesheet page with CSV download
tasks.description: TimesheetPage.tsx with week navigation (startOfIsoWeek, weekDayKeys, shiftWeekStart, weekRange), the person filter for managers, WeekGridTable built by buildWeekGrid, the totals and the export button downloading the blob from timeApi.exportCsv.

tasks.title: Client tests for the helpers and the UI
tasks.description: client/src/features/time/__tests__/duration.test.ts, timesheet.test.ts and timeUi.test.tsx covering the duration parsing and formatting, the week grid and the time UI states.
